data.title: 帕瓦 · 烤肉派对的总统欢宴
data.description: 热气蒸腾的烤肉店内，帕瓦双手抓着滋滋冒油的烤牛排大骨头，两颊塞得鼓鼓囊囊，满嘴油光却得意洋洋地向周围宣布自己的战绩。
data.action: eating huge grilled meat bone, stuffed cheeks, overjoyed chaotic expression
data.lighting: warm golden tavern lamps and sizzling grill smoke
data.promptProse: Sitting at a lively yakiniku table surrounded by sizzling grills, Power happily chomps on a massive grilled meat bone with cheeks puffed full and eyes sparkling with glee.
data.animaCaption: Power joyfully feasting on a giant grilled meat bone at a restaurant.
